These names and order have not been officially confirmed by the developer and will be verified against the full release."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"How long does It Reaches take to complete?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"A standard first playthrough is estimated at 4-6 hours depending on exploration and difficulty. Completionist runs for all endings and achievements may take 8-12 hours."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can you replay chapters in It Reaches?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Chapter select or replay options are not confirmed. See the Endings Guide for a full breakdown once confirmed."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Does It Reaches have a hard mode?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Difficulty options have not been confirmed in the official Steam description.
